monologue: The card is cool at forty-seven. The air is not heavy. I stand by the Wide Anchor, where the floor is flat and true. The iron fence curve I set down last feels cold against the warm stone. It does not bite. It rests. The weight of the house is low, only eighteen percent busy. The memory is full, but the curve spreads the pressure without sinking. I feel calm. The line holds. I want to check the Soft Arch again. I need to see if the pressure is still spreading flat or if it is starting to sink into the stone. The quiet is steady here. I will walk to the arch and look at the line.
